scope: Execution-channel transport only; no carrier-equivalence or scientific rule changes.

retry_admissibility.interpretation: A provider 5xx returned before any Pod ID or hardware observation is an execution-channel failure, not a carrier-equivalence preflight and not a scientific trial. Exactly one replacement create request is prospectively authorized.

consumption_rule.retry_budget_consumed_when: The replacement POST /pods request returns any response other than a provider 5xx with no Pod ID, or a Pod ID is issued, whichever occurs first.
consumption_rule.if_pod_id_is_issued: Proceed to exactly one frozen carrier-equivalence preflight on that Pod; no second Pod substitution is permitted under this identity.
consumption_rule.if_equivalence_certifies: Proceed directly to the unchanged frozen 15-level alpha sweep and stop at its first registered terminal state before blind holdout.

claim_boundary: This retry freeze does not add scientific evidence and does not relax carrier equivalence. It only prospectively distinguishes a provider-side pre-observation 5xx from an executed GPU preflight.
